summary_en: This Phase 2 pilot study tests a sequence of currently approved cancer drugs, given in order as "strikes," in people with hormone positive, HER2 negative metastatic breast cancer. The strikes include Taxotere, Cytoxan, sacituzumab govitecan or trastuzumab deruxtecan, Xeloda, and fulvestrant with ribociclib or abemaciclib, and most strikes are given every 21 days for 4 or 5 cycles. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to see whether this sequence is practical to give.
summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase 2 evalúa una secuencia de medicamentos contra el cáncer ya aprobados, administrados en orden como "golpes", en personas con cáncer de mama metastásico positivo para hormonas y negativo para HER2. Los golpes incluyen Taxotere, Cytoxan, sacituzumab govitecan o trastuzumab deruxtecan, Xeloda, y fulvestrant con ribociclib o abemaciclib, y la mayoría de los golpes se administran cada 21 días durante 4 o 5 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro señala que el estudio busca saber si esta secuencia es práctica de administrar.
who_for: Hormone positive, HER2 negative metastatic breast cancer confirmed by biopsy
Previously treated with an aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen
not_for: Previously received fulvestrant for breast cancer
Brain or other active central nervous system metastases
Active infection, including HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C, under the stated rules
Investigational drug within 30 days before the first study dose
